## Quarto

Quarto enables you to weave together content and executable code into a finished document. To learn more about Quarto see <https://quarto.org>.

## Running Code

When you click the **Render** button a document will be generated that includes both content and the output of embedded code. You can embed code like this:

```{r}
1 + 1
```

You can add options to executable code like this

```{r}
#| echo: false
2 * 2
```

The `echo: false` option disables the printing of code (only output is displayed).

```{r librerias}

library(tidyverse)

library(sf)

library(igraph)
library(tidygraph)

library(sfnetworks)


```

```{r descripcion red}

nodes <- data.frame(
  id = c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5),
  name = c(
    "parque_rivadavia",
    "primera_junta",
    "est_acoyte",
    "est_primera_junta",
    "club_ferro"
  )
)



edges <- data.frame (
  from  =  c(1, 1, 1, 2, 3, 4 ),   
  to  = c (2, 3, 4, 3, 5, 5)
)

edges$distance <- c (5, 8, 4, 3, 6, 2)

igraph::degree(net)
#Para cada nodo ¿cuantas conexiones tiene?
```

```{r}


g <- graph_from_data_frame(
  d = edges,
  vertices = nodes,
  directed = FALSE
)
g

```

```{r}
degree(g)
components(g)
components(g)$no
edges$distance
  

shortest_paths(
  g,
  from = "parque_rivadavia",
  to = "club_ferro",
  weights = E(g)$distance
)
#El camino mas corto en distancia

distances(
  g,
  v = "parque_rivadavia",
  to = "club_ferro",
  weights = E(g)$distance
)
#Cuanto cuesta en distancia llegar

distances(
  g,                          #sobre que grafo
  weights = E(g)$distance     #que costo usar
)
#Calculá, para los nodos de g, la distancia mínima entre ellos, usando distance como peso de las aristas.


shortest_paths(
  g,
  from = "primera_junta",
  to = "est_primera_junta",
  weights = E(g)$distance
)
```

```{text}

GRAFO
 │
 ├── degree()
 │      └── ¿cuántas conexiones tiene cada nodo?
 │
 ├── components()
 │      └── ¿cuántos componentes conexos hay?
 │
 ├── distances()
 │      └── ¿cuál es el costo mínimo entre nodos?
 │
 └── shortest_paths()
        └── ¿por qué nodos pasa ese camino mínimo?

```
